english.title: Bounty: Gnarlpine Furbolg
english.objective: Shayla Nightbreeze on the road outside of Darnassus wants you to bring her 15 Gnarlpine Fangs.
english.progress: Teldrassil cannot thrive with corruption tainting the land. Drive the Gnarlpine from this forest, once and for all.
english.complete: You have served well, <name>. You shall be rewarded for your contribution.
english.detail:
By strict orders from the Sentinels, I am commissioning a bounty on the Gnarlpine. They are no longer friends of the forest. Their corruption has left them mindless threats to our people and the creatures of the glade.

As decreed, you shall be rewarded for removing the furbolg menaces from Teldrassil. Bring to me their fangs as proof of your deeds.

You will find furbolg concentrated in Ban'ethil Hollow, west of Dolanaar and south of the road, and in Starbreeze Village to the east.

decision: UA1.0.0 corrects its obsolete label and prior wording to the English-supported text already shipped; no current Myanmar correction needed. Keep genericUNUSED runtimealias disabled.
